# Advanced Dental Clinic Jabalpur

> Dr. Mulchandani's Advanced Ranjhi Dental Hospital is a dental clinic in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, India, offering painless, modern dentistry since 2009.

## Key facts

- Name: Dr. Mulchandani's Advanced Ranjhi Dental Hospital (Advanced Dental Clinic Jabalpur)
- Address: Main Road, Ranjhi, Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh 482005, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 89827 77707
- Email: advanceddentaljabalpur@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 10:00 AM–8:30 PM. 24×7 emergency support.
- Experience: 15+ years serving Jabalpur
- Chief Dental Surgeon: Dr. Akhilesh Mulchandani (BDS, MDS Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopaedics, Fellowship in Implantology - Germany)

## Treatments offered

- Orthodontics (metal, ceramic, lingual braces)
- Invisalign clear aligners
- Dental implants (single tooth, full arch, immediate loading)
- Cosmetic dentistry (whitening, veneers, smile design)
- Periodontics & gum treatment
- Restorative dentistry (root canal, crowns, fillings)
- Preventive care (checkups, cleaning, sealants)
